title: Algerian Lamb Tagine with Japanese Twist
description: A fusion of Japanese and Algerian flavors, this lamb tagine is a hearty and aromatic dish perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Algerian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and paprika

instructions: 1. Marinate lamb in soy sauce for at least 30 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
3. Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
4. Add Algerian spices and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add kissed rose petals and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Add sushi rice and stir to combine.
7. Cover and transfer to oven. Cook at 300°F for 2 hours.
8. Serve hot, garnished with green onions and fresh cilantro.
9. Drizzle with indulgent honey before serving.
